statement: Version 5 registered in C24's P07 remediation, before the complete production package (with the sealed Harness engine) was measured: the footprint is measured on what ships and its limits add exactly the engine's pinned sizes to the first slice's allowance (prior results: evidence/C24/footprint-v4-without-engine-20261023.json). Measurement records must name this hash and start after this time. The change needs owner or independent reviewer acknowledgement (C24's review is asked for it).
